standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 6327-6330: C has genus 0, so deg(omega_C) = -2[k' : k].

core_obligations: The restriction sequence (proof lines 6321-6326): let X' be as in the rational bridge example; the closed-subscheme lemmas for nodal curves give the short exact sequence 0 -> omega_C -> omega_X|_C -> O_{C \cap X'} -> 0.

The two degrees (lines 6327-6330): with k''/k'/k as in the example, C has genus 0 so deg(omega_C) = -2[k' : k] by Riemann-Roch, and the intersection C \cap X' is Spec(k'') with [k'' : k] = 2[k' : k], so deg(C \cap X') = 2[k' : k].
proof_roadmap: Recall the bridge setup and the restriction sequence from the closed-subscheme lemmas.
Compute deg(omega_C) from genus 0 and deg(C \cap X') from the field degrees.
Add the two degrees to get zero.

H2: short numerical computation.
